### Props

| Name    | Type                                                              | Required | Default | Description                                                      |
| ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `item`  | `{label: string, url: string, icon: string, children?: object[]}` | ✓        | —       | Single menu item being edited (`{label, url, icon, children?}`). |
| `depth` | `number`                                                          |          | `1`     | 1-indexed depth — drives the indent and the depth label.         |
| `path`  | `number[]`                                                        | ✓        | —       | Path of indices from the root to this item (e.g. `[0, 2]`).      |

### Events

| Name          | Payload | Description                                                                                                  |
| ------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `add-child`   | —       | Fired to add a child row; payload `{path}` carries the parent's index path.                                  |
| `remove-item` | —       | Fired to remove a row; payload `{path}` carries the row's index path.                                        |
| `update-item` | —       | Fired when a field changes; payload `{path, item}` carries the row's index path and the updated item object. |
